Subject: Elite Track — registrant routing, concierge slate & demo prioritization

Morning team — quick recap from last night's Elite Track webinar (60m, technical deep-dive). We had ~480 registrants, 112 live attendees and 38 qualified requests captured during Q&A. I exported the attendee list and sketched a short concierge plan.

High-level segmentation (columns in the CSV):
- Tier A (enterprise accounts; high fit): 12 accounts — senior engineering/infra titles + clear procurement signals
- Tier B (mid-market, product-led): 54 accounts — product/engineering champions, follow-up recommended within 48 hours
- Tier C (SMB / partner leads): remaining registrants for nurture

Asks:
1) SDRs: please claim Tier A accounts first, target outreach + calendar blocks for discovery/demo this week.
2) CS: prepare a 20-min technical concierge walkthrough for any Tier A that requests it; I left templated slide notes in the Drive folder.
3) Ops: mark HubSpot list_45721 for webhook sync so marketing can trigger the nurture drip.

Attachments: attendee export (elite-track-attendees-20270917.csv) and concierge-playbook-v1.pdf. I highlighted SableTech and Vertex Solutions rows — SableTech shows an active procurement tag; Vertex has a product-eval comment from Amanda Zhou in the notes.

Priority calendar guidance: aim for demo windows in local business hours for the account (US/PST preferred for these 12). If you need an intro template, use the one in the Drive (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-elite-track-registrants
HubSpot list: list_45721

Thanks — Marcus
